description: Create a user in THIS tenant (admins only). No invitation or activation email is sent; the password is random and unknown to anyone — set one on the Team page if the person needs web login. Required: email. Optional: first_name, last_name, role (admin|planner|viewer|caller, default planner), phone (WhatsApp number WITH country code, e.g. +41 78 123 45 67), access_web / access_mcp (default true), access_whatsapp (default false; needs phone). A WhatsApp message from that phone to the tenant's WhatsApp number is then recognised as this user.

access_mcp.description: Allow API keys and MCP clients (default true)

access_whatsapp.description: Allow talking to the agent via WhatsApp (default false; needs phone)

role.description: Tenant role: admin, planner (default), viewer or caller

name: create_tenant_user
